items.title: Binance hack rattles crypto markets as BNB falls 7%, Bitcoin slides
items.summary: Bitcoin and Ether tumbled as the broader crypto market fell 3.3%, with reports of suspicious multibillion-dollar transfers from Binance-linked wallets fueling uncertainty.

items.title: Binance Drained of $5.5 Billion in Suspected Hack, Tether and Circle Freeze $1.8 Billion
items.summary: An on-chain tally puts the suspected Binance drain at $5.57 billion across three blockchains, as Tether and Circle froze $1.8 billion.

items.title: Binance investigating hack as suspicious outflows reach up to $5.8 billion
items.summary: Tether and Circle froze $1.79 billion in USDT and USDC after billions moved out of Binance hot wallets. Binance says it is investigating.

items.title: Trump's crypto firm joins Tether, Circle, and Ripple in $2.6 billion stablecoin freeze as Binance hack outflows near $6 billion
items.summary: Stablecoin issuers, including Tether, Circle, Ripple, and World Liberty Financial, have frozen more than $2.6 billion in digital assets linked to a suspected Binance security breach.

items.title: Bitcoin Price Slides Below $79,000 as Binance Loses $5.8 Billion in Massive Hack
items.summary: Bitcoin price fell below $79,000 as reports of a suspected Binance hack, with outflows of up to $5.8 billion, prompted Tether and Circle to freeze roughly $1.8 to $2.4 billion in stablecoins.

items.title: Binance loses $5.7 billion in 'biggest crypto hack in history'
items.summary: Crypto prices are sliding on the news, with bitcoin falling back to $79,000.

items.title: Polymarket suspended trading amid reports of user funds being drained
items.summary: The prediction markets platform halted trading on Thursday after it reported one of its third party providers had been compromised.

items.title: Polymarket Pauses Trading as Prediction Market Investigates Security Incident
items.summary: Polymarket restricted trading and paused relayer actions as users report funds leaving their accounts.

items.title: Polymarket resumes trading after $2.65 million exploit, says third-party provider was compromised
items.summary: After over $2.5 million was lost within minutes on Polymarket, the platform said it has since placed its exchange in cancel-only mode.

items.title: HYPE surges 15% as NYSE parent ICE moves to bring Hyperliquid perps to US
items.summary: NYSE parent ICE will partner with and invest in Trade[XYZ] to launch regulated, Hyperliquid-based perpetual futures in the U.S.

items.title: Stanley Druckenmiller's first X post backs Hyperliquid venture after $23 million indirect investment
items.summary: The billionaire investor disclosed an investment in Trade[XYZ] as the platform teams up with the NYSE's parent company.

items.title: Strategy (MSTR) Posts Record Operating Income as Bitcoin Rebounds in Q3 2026
items.summary: Strategy reported record $20.91 billion in Q3 2026 operating income, driven by Bitcoin's rebound.

items.title: Coinbase Swings to $719 Million Q3 Profit on Crypto Gains
items.summary: Coinbase reported third-quarter net income of $719 million, driven largely by gains on its crypto holdings.

items.title: Strategy reports $19.5 billion in Q3 net income as preferred shareholders approve daily dividends
items.summary: Strategy reported $19.53B in Q3 net income on a $20.91B bitcoin gain, holds 848,517 BTC.

items.title: Bitcoin whipsaws below $79,000 as Binance hot wallet reportedly drained by Tornado Cash-linked wallet
items.summary: Bitcoin hit an intraday low of $78,297 on Binance spot on Oct. 29.

items.title: Polymarket suspends trading after third-party breach leads to user losses
items.summary: Polymarket said one of its third-party providers was breached after users reported seeing their accounts drained.

items.title: Uniswap Labs opens fee conversion tool TJAR to apps, starting with Robinhood
items.summary: Uniswap Labs has opened up its Token Jar fee conversion system to other apps through a new tool called TJAR.

items.title: From rivals to partners: Polygon and Solana team to bring stablecoin payments to banks
items.summary: The two networks are setting aside their rivalry to connect Solana's stablecoin activity with Polygon's banking, wallet and payment infrastructure.
